translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: K'eesetuwaa Wod'eeddino
Daawite Gaate katamaappe bak'atiide, Adulaama katamaa matan de'iyaa gonggoluwaa beedda; Aa ishatuwaanne Aa aawuwaa soo Asay ubbay hewaa siseedda wode, unttunttu yaa duge aakko wod'd'eeddino.
Metooteeddawanttu, woy ac'uwan geleeddawanttu, woy sa'ay iiteeddawanttu ubbatuu Daawitakko shiik'eeddino; I unttunttoo kaappuwaa gideedda. Itti oyddu s'eetuwaa gidiyaa Asay aanana de'ee.

Daawite he saappe denddiide, Moo'aaben de'iyaa Mis'ip'p'a beedda; Moo'aabe kaatiyaa, «S'oossay taw ootsanabaa taani erana gakkanaw ta aattonne ta aawuwaa ne matan wotsissaarikkii» yaagiide woosseedda.
Hewaa diraw, Daawite unttuntta Moo'aabe kaatiyaa matan wotseedda; geesuwaa giddon Daawite k'osetti utteedda wode ubbaan unttunttu kaatiyaa matan de'eeddino.
Hewaappe guyyiyaan, timbbitiyaa odiyaa Gaadi Daawitakko yiide, «Geesuwaa giddon gam"oppa; ha saappe denddaade Yihudaa gadiyaa ba» yaageedda; Daawite he saappe Hereta wora beedda.

Daawitenne Aa Asay beetteeddawaa Saa'ooli siseedda; Saa'ooli Gib'aa katamaa matan de'iyaa deriyaan, tamaariskka geetettiyaa mitsaa garssan tooraa oyk'k'iide utteedda; Aa oosanchchatuu Aa dooddiide ek'k'eeddinno.

Saa'ooli unttuntta, «Hinttenttoo, Biiniyaama asatoo, sisite! Isseya na'ay goshshaanne woyniyaa tokkiyaa sa'aa hinttenttu ubbaw immanee? Shaalak'atuwaanne s'eetuwaa kaappatuwaa ootsiide hinttentta suntsanee?

Hinttenttu ubbay ta bolla mak'etteeddita; ta na'ay Isseya na'aanna k'aalaa c'aak'uwaa c'ak'k'eteeddawaa ooninne taw odibeenna. Hintteppe itti asaynne taw k'arettenna; hachchewaadankka ta na'ay ta k'oomaa taana wod'isanaw dentseeddawaa ooninne taw odibeenna» yaageedda.
Saa'oola oosanchchatuwaanna ek'k'eedda Edoomiyaa Doyk'i Saa'oola, «Isseya na'ay Ahis'uuba na'aa Abimeleekakko Nooba katamaa beeddawaa taani be'aaddi.
Abimeleeki Daawite ootsanabaa Med'inaa Godaa oochcheedda; yaatiide Daawitaw shink'k'aa immeedda; k'ay Piliss's'eemiyaa Gooliyaada mashshaakka aw immeedda» yaageedda.
Hewaappe guyyiyaan, Ahis'uuba na'aa k'eesiyaa Abimeleekanne Nooba kataman k'eesatuwaa gidiide de'iyaa Aa aawuwaa soo asaa ubbaa kaatii s'eesissina, unttunttu kaatiyaakko yeeddino.
Saa'ooli Abimeleeka, «Ahis'uuba na'aw, sisa» yaageedda. Abimeleeki, «Ero ta godaw» yaageedda.
Saa'ooli Aa, «Neeninne Isseya na'ay ta bolla ayaw mak'etteeddite? Neeni aw ukitsaanne mashshaa immaade, I taana wod'anaw denddana mala, aw S'oossaa ayaw oochchaaddii?» yaageedda.
Abimeleeki kaatiyaa, «Ne k'oomatuwaa ubbaa gidduwaan Daawitedan ammanettiyaawe, kaatiyaanna bolloteeddawe, neena naagiyaawantta azaziyaawenne ne soo asaa giddon loytsi bonchchettiyaawe haray oonee?

Taani aw S'oossaa oochchishin, hawe taw koyro? gidenna! Kaatiyaw, taana ne k'oomaa woy ta aawuwaa soo asaa ubbaa ayinne moottoppa; ayaw gooppe, taani ne k'oomay ha yewuwaa guutsa gidina wolk'k'aama gidinakka mule erikke» yaageedda.
Kaatii, «Abimeleeka, neeninne ne aawuwaa golliyaa Asay ubbay hayk'k'ana» yaageedda.

Hewaappe guyyiyaan, Saa'ooli bare matan ek'k'iide naagiyaawantta, «Med'inaa Godaa k'eesetuwaa wod'ite; ayaw gooppe, unttunttukka Daawita maaddeeddino; Daawite bak'ateeddawaa eriidde, taw odibeykkino» yaageedda. Shin kaatiyaa oosanchchatuu Med'inaa Godaa k'eesatuwaa bolla barenttu kushiyaa wotsennan is's'eeddino.
Yaatina kaatii Doyk'a, «K'eesetuwaa neeni wod'a» yaagiide azazeedda. Edoomiyaa Doyk'i k'eesetuwaa shoc'eedda; he gallassi eefuudiyaa mayyeedda hosppun tammanne ichcheshu k'eesetuwaa I wod'eedda.

Hewaa bollakka k'eesatuwaa katamaa, Nooba k'ara mashshaan busakkeedda; he kataman de'iyaa attumawaa, mac'c'awaa, naanaa, k'eeri naanaa, mehetuwaa, haretuwaanne dorssatuwaa k'ara mashshaan Doyk'i suppu ootseedda.
Shin Ahis'uuba na'aa Abimeleeka naanatuwaappe Abiyaataara geetettiyaa itti na'ay kessi akkiide, Daawitakko bak'ateedda.
Saa'ooli Med'inaa Godaa k'eesetuwaa wod'eeddawaa Daawitaw odeedda.
Daawite Abiyaataara, «Edoomiyaa Doyk'i he sa'aan de'iyaawaa taani be'eedda wode, I Saa'oolaw odanawaa he gallassi eraad. Ne aawuwaa soo asaa ubbaa hayk'oo ooshettiyaawe taana.
Simmi neeni taananna de'a; yayyoppa. Neena wod'anaw koyiyaa uray taana wod'anaw koyiyaawaa; shin neeni ta matan saro de'ana» yaageedda.
